text:
alex: Heads-up — started a hot-swap canary for model `rwd-v3-int4` at 10% traffic. Please watch latency and MRR slices.
jamie: thanks, tagging @sarah for fidelity checks. any change to routing?
sarah: no routing changes, same route weights. I'll kick off the slice-level eval now.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout: rwd-v3-int4 -> traffic 0% -> 10% (started). Monitoring p50/p95/p99 + eval hook.
matt: saw a small bump in p50 on a local bench earlier, nothing huge. main concern p99.
alex: if p99 goes > 20% above baseline we auto-fallback per `promote_thresholds` rule. current auto-fallback = `p99_delta_pct >= 20` or `mrr_delta_pct <= -1.5`
jamie: copied. what about noisier slices like longcontext and docs-summarize?
sarah: starting targeted slices: `longcontext`, `multi-turn-help`, `docs-summarize`. will post quick metrics.
ops-bot: metric-hook: slice=longcontext p99 baseline=250ms current=310ms (+24%).
matt: that's above the 20% fallback threshold for that slice. Is that transient? sample size?
sarah: sample n=1200 for last 15m on longcontext, CI looks ok. MRR drop on that slice: 0.914 -> 0.901 (-1.43%).
ajex: (typo) alex: thanks — that's right below the MRR fallback of 1.5%. but p99 exceeded 20% so fallback should trigger.
jamie: do we run a quick smoke where we reroute longcontext to baseline model and keep rest on canary?
sarah: yes, can do a micro-slice rollback. opening rollout control.
ops-bot: control action: routed slice=longcontext -> rwd-v2 (baseline) at 10:52:13 UTC. Canary remains at 10% global.
matt: post-reroute p99 longcontext -> 255ms (back near baseline). looks like quantized path has higher tail for longcontext.
alex: we should update the `stability-signal` to include slice-aware p99 weighting. Current rule treats global p99 only.
jamie: agreed — propose: compute weighted p99 where long tails on heavy-slices count 2x for fallback. Would have caught this earlier.
sarah: I'll draft a quick PR to `rl-gates` with the weighted rule and an override for `longcontext` until we have kernel-level fix.
matt: also log an infra ticket: profiler shows konv kernel experiencing slower gather on seq_len>1024 with int4 path.
ops-bot: ticket created: INF-8292 (kernel gather int4 tail perf).
alex: ok — immediate plan: 1) micro-slice rollback done, 2) keep canary at 10% for 30m while we monitor other slices, 3) patch gate to weighted-p99 rule, 4) infra ticket for kernel perf.
jamie: +1. If any other slice crosses p99_delta >= 15% escalate to oncall.
sarah: posting the eval dump: ````
Canary quick eval (last 30m):
- global p50: 44ms -> 46ms (+4.5%)
- global p99: 218ms -> 290ms (+33%)
- global MRR: 0.823 -> 0.816 (-0.85%)
- longcontext p99: +24% (see above)
- docs-summarize p99: +6%
````
matt: good data, looks localized to longcontext primarily.
alex: lowering noise: set `promote_thresholds.p99_delta_pct` -> 15 for next hour so we are more conservative while kernel fix in flight.
jamie: acked. I'll update control plane and notify support to watch any customer reports.
ops-bot: control update: `promote_thresholds.p99_delta_pct` set to 15% (temporary) by jamie at 10:58:01 UTC.
sarah: thanks — I'll keep an eye on MRR drift and push a full slice report in 30m.
matt: if kernel fix ETA > 48h we should revert micro-slice rule to block int4 for seq_len>1024 by default.
alex: agreed. good catch team. :thumbsup:
jamie: +1, filing follow-up to tighten Canary gating docs with slice-aware examples.
sarah: uploading logs to the canary-run bucket: s3://redwood-canary/runs/6100001234/ evaluation.json
ops-bot: deploybot: Canary status -> 10% (stable) after micro-slice rollback. Monitoring continues.
alex: closing for now — will reopen if anything else pops. thanks everyone.
